# prod-boot-options

runProdApp boot options: mail, kmsMode, fileStorage, demoMode and signal handling declared as options instead of hand-wired in bin/main.ts.

## README

# Prod boot options

Declare mail, KMS, file storage, demo mode, seeds and signal handling as
`runProdApp` options instead of wiring them by hand in `bin/main.ts`. Each
option mounts the matching bundled feature, reads its env block and fails
the boot with a clear message when the env is incomplete.

## What it shows

- **`mail`**: `{ transport: "smtp-env" }` mounts `channel-email` with an
  SMTP transport from `SMTP_*` and makes the auth mail flows use it.
  `"inmemory"` is for dev and tests and is rejected in production.
- **`kmsMode`**: `"required"` builds the KMS adapter and blind-index key from
  `PLATFORM_KEK`, `SUBJECT_KEYS_DATABASE_URL` and `KUMIKO_BLIND_INDEX_KEY` and
  aborts without them. `"optional"` uses them when present.
  `{ plaintextReason }` stores PII in plaintext on purpose.
- **`fileStorage`**: `{ provider: "auto" }` mounts the S3 provider when
  `S3_BUCKET`, `S3_REGION`, `S3_ACCESS_KEY` and `S3_SECRET_KEY` are complete. In
  production a partial S3 env aborts the boot; in dev it falls back to
  in-memory storage.
- **`demoMode`**: `GET /demo-mode` publishes the notice, and `readOnly: true`
  answers every write except query and login with `403 demo_read_only`.
- **`signals`**: SIGTERM and SIGINT run `stop()` with a drain timeout, then
  exit 0, or exit 1 on timeout or error. `signals: false` leaves the process
  signals to the host.
- **`seeds`**: `{ demoTenant, demoAdminFromEnv, sysadminFromEnv, run }`
  replaces hand-written tenant and admin seeds; needs the auth features (not
  mounted here).
- **`billing`**: `{ stripe: { priceToTier }, defaultTier }` mounts the Stripe
  bridge and the tier-sync webhook route; needs `billing-foundation` and
  `tier-engine`.

## Flow

1. `src/app.ts` lists the features and the boot options.
2. `bin/server.ts` passes both to `runProdApp`.
3. The test boots with `KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot`, which runs the full
   validation and exits before any DB or Redis connection: a complete
   production env passes, a partial S3 or missing KMS env aborts the boot,
   and a missing `SMTP_HOST` shows up in the env inventory under
   `runProdApp.mail`, because the options add their env blocks to the app's
   `envSchema`.

## Run

```bash
bun test samples/recipes/prod-boot-options
```

### src/__tests__/boot-options.test.ts

```ts
// KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot validates the whole wiring and exits before any
// DB/Redis connection, so the recipe's options are checked without infra.

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, spyOn, test } from "bun:test";
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { composeEnvSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/env";
import { runProdApp } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime";
import { appFeatures, bootOptions } from "../app";

const PRODUCTION_BOOT_ENV: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  DATABASE_URL: "postgres://recipe:recipe@127.0.0.1:1/recipe",
  REDIS_URL: "redis://127.0.0.1:1",
  JWT_SECRET: "r".repeat(32),
  KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV: "boot",
  NODE_ENV: "production",
  SMTP_HOST: "smtp.recipe.example",
  PLATFORM_KEK: randomBytes(32).toString("base64"),
  SUBJECT_KEYS_DATABASE_URL: "postgres://kms:kms@127.0.0.1:1/subject_keys",
  KUMIKO_BLIND_INDEX_KEY: randomBytes(32).toString("base64"),
  S3_BUCKET: "recipe",
  S3_REGION: "eu-central",
  S3_ACCESS_KEY: "access",
  S3_SECRET_KEY: "secret",
};

function withoutKey(key: string): Record<string, string> {
  const { [key]: _dropped, ...rest } = PRODUCTION_BOOT_ENV;
  return rest;
}

async function bootValidate(envSource: Record<string, string>): Promise<void> {
  const features = appFeatures();
  const handle = await runProdApp({
    features,
    envSchema: composeEnvSchema({ features: [] }),
    autoListen: false,
    migrations: false,
    envSource,
    ...bootOptions(envSource),
  });
  await handle.stop();
}

describe("prod boot options recipe", () => {
  let logSpy: ReturnType<typeof spyOn>;
  let warnSpy: ReturnType<typeof spyOn>;
  beforeEach(() => {
    logSpy = spyOn(console, "log").mockImplementation(() => {});
    warnSpy = spyOn(console, "warn").mockImplementation(() => {});
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    logSpy.mockRestore();
    warnSpy.mockRestore();
  });

  test("a complete production env passes boot validation", async () => {
    await bootValidate({ ...PRODUCTION_BOOT_ENV });
    const lines = logSpy.mock.calls.map((call: unknown[]) => String(call[0]));
    expect(lines.some((line: string) => line.includes("boot validation OK"))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("an incomplete S3 env aborts the production boot", async () => {
    await expect(bootValidate(withoutKey("S3_BUCKET"))).rejects.toThrow(/S3_BUCKET/);
  });

  test("the dry run reports a missing SMTP host from the mail option's env block", async () => {
    await bootValidate(withoutKey("SMTP_HOST"));
    const lines = logSpy.mock.calls.map((call: unknown[]) => String(call[0]));
    const inventory = lines.find((line: string) => line.startsWith("Env check")) ?? "";
    expect(inventory).toMatch(/SMTP_HOST\s+runProdApp\.mail\s+required\s+.*missing/i);
    expect(lines.some((line: string) => line.includes("boot validation OK"))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a missing KMS trio aborts the boot under kmsMode required", async () => {
    const envSource = withoutKey("PLATFORM_KEK");
    delete envSource["SUBJECT_KEYS_DATABASE_URL"];
    delete envSource["KUMIKO_BLIND_INDEX_KEY"];
    await expect(bootValidate(envSource)).rejects.toThrow(/kmsMode "required"/);
  });
});
```

### src/app.ts

```ts
import { createConfigFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import { createDeliveryFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/delivery";
import { createFileFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-foundation";
import { createTenantFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant";
import type { RunProdAppOptions } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime";

export function appFeatures(): RunProdAppOptions["features"] {
  return [
    createConfigFeature(),
    createTenantFeature(),
    createDeliveryFeature(),
    createFileFoundationFeature(),
  ];
}

type BootOptions = Pick<
  RunProdAppOptions,
  "mail" | "kmsMode" | "fileStorage" | "demoMode" | "signals"
>;

export function bootOptions(envSource: Record<string, string | undefined>): BootOptions {
  return {
    mail: { transport: "smtp-env", from: "Recipe <noreply@recipe.example>" },
    kmsMode: "required",
    fileStorage: { provider: "auto" },
    demoMode: {
      readOnly: envSource["DEMO_READ_ONLY"] === "true",
      notice: { text: { en: "This demo is read-only.", de: "Diese Demo ist schreibgeschützt." } },
    },
    signals: { drainTimeoutMs: 20_000 },
  };
}
```
